bio: Supervised by chef Julien Roucheteau, this restaurant is a welcome addition to the fine dining options offered by this high-class establishment, in particular, thanks to a bargain-priced menu that changes weekly. The contemporary Mediterranean repertory takes inspiration from the local terroir – hence a crudo of marinated line-fished white tuna; stuffed provençal aubergines; melt-in-the-mouth beef stew with Swiss chard and house gnocchis. You might also like to sample their bouillabaisse (Fri and Sat), traditional octopus dishes from the Mediterranean or rockfish soup. Diners are seated in a bistro-style setting that is suitably buzzy and casual.
